falsification_checks.name: Antecedência do alerta

falsification_checks.name: Contexto da competição

falsification_checks.name: Robustez entre dias

falsification_checks.name: Diferença face ao mercado
falsification_checks.required: >=1000 FT after hypothesis registration across >=3 weeks; mean residual > 5 pp

falsification_checks.name: Linha como explicação alternativa

falsification_checks.name: Jogos comparáveis
falsification_checks.required: 30 no-reuse peers within lambda 0.25 and lead time 6h

falsification_checks.name: Validação cronológica
falsification_checks.required: 1000 registered genuine FT in >=3 weeks AND source coverage 14-day gate

limitations: Only formally registered hypotheses are shown as scientific hypotheses; V5 exploratory rankings are not promoted.
Source of truth is hash-linked JSONL, not the latest dashboard, and never a cached betting record.
FT from the independent LAB ledger may be visible before it appears in the V6 scientific evidence stream; they are labelled separately.
Old V4 edits are not reconstructed retroactively; no V4 source version is claimed unless it was stored before known_at.
Reported market p(Over 2.5) is a model-derived reference, not a tradable O2.5 quote.
No independent winning edge, ROI or scientific validation is claimed.
GitHub links show the current main history; SHA hashes identify the precise immutable observations.
